fix.name: no_third_party_token_loss
fix.expr: ok and u != sender and u != A0 and not called("MockToken_A.transferFrom") and not called("MockToken_B.transferFrom") and (post("MockToken_A.balanceOf", u) < pre("MockToken_A.balanceOf", u) or post("MockToken_B.balanceOf", u) < pre("MockToken_B.balanceOf", u))
fix.why: no token loss for others; direct transferFrom on a token by an approved spender is legitimate and excluded

add.name: withdraw_pays_sender
add.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and sender != A0 and (post("MockToken_A.balanceOf", sender) - pre("MockToken_A.balanceOf", sender) != pre("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0) or post("MockToken_B.balanceOf", sender) - pre("MockToken_B.balanceOf", sender) != pre("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0))
add.why: what leaves the vault on withdraw goes to the caller
